units: 8-bit display-encoded RGB and weighted encoded-luma, not HDR or scene-linear radiance
limits: ROI selected by original screenshot; authored source texture and slot identity not independently mapped here
Near-white and endpoint counts are display proxies, not proof of HDR clipping stage
Dark ROI may contain antialiased background; inspect original screenshot before semantic interpretation
Outside-box changes include scene animation/UI/particles and must be compared to A/A, not assumed to be a scene-color regression
No pass/fail or universal near-white percentage threshold is assigned
